quotes.name: Vladimir Gonzalez
quotes.quote: Honestly, the vibe is a lot less tense than you'd think. We all know the business side of it — somebody's gonna get moved or sent down, that's just how it goes. What I tell the young guys is you can't control what Paulson decides. You just control how you show up. And truth be told, it's a good problem for the A's to have. Means we got depth, and that's how you win. I earned my spot, sure, but I remember what it was like trying to crack a crowded room. You just hope the decision gets made quick so whoever it is lands somewhere they can play.
